title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 5.28
exact_target: Historical question: are the small-scale interior and boundary moduli of continuity asymptotically equal for every disc-algebra function? The source update records a negative answer.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2305028 (AMR-022-5028). CC BY 4.0.
